name: run_site_wpcli_commands
title: Run Site WP-CLI Commands
description:
Schedules one or more WP-CLI commands to run on a Pressable WordPress site. Each command runs asynchronously on the site's SSH host; the tool returns a list of background job ids that correspond to each queued command.

The "wp " prefix is added automatically — pass just the rest of the command (e.g. "plugin list", "core version", "option get blogname"). The commands argument must be an array, even for a single command. Execution is asynchronous: call get_site_wordpress_operation with a returned job_id to read that command's status and captured output, or list_site_wordpress_operations for the whole history. Output and errors are also recorded in the site's activity log under action "ssh.command".

site_id.description: The numeric ID of the Pressable site

commands.description: WP-CLI commands to run, without the leading "wp " prefix (e.g. ["plugin list", "core version"])
